metadata.name: Nadi Amsha
metadata.birth_time_sensitivity: 1 minute error = ~0.17 degrees = ~0.85 amshas — very sensitive to accurate birth time

lagna_nadi_amsha.description: Nadi Amsha of the Ascendant indicates the soul's fundamental nature
lagna_nadi_amsha.adi_lagna: Soul here to initiate — pioneering, restless, communicative lifetime
lagna_nadi_amsha.madhya_lagna: Soul here to transform — active, leadership, intense lifetime
lagna_nadi_amsha.antya_lagna: Soul here to complete — consolidating, stabilizing, moksha-oriented lifetime

planet_nadi_amsha_signs.description: The sign each planet falls in within D-150 shows its most refined karmic quality
planet_nadi_amsha_signs.interpretation_principle: Read the D-150 sign lord and its relationship to D-1 chart — the sublord reveals the finest operational level of each planet's energy
planet_nadi_amsha_signs.sun: D-150 Sun sign = the soul's deepest ego-expression channel
planet_nadi_amsha_signs.moon: D-150 Moon sign = the most refined emotional-karmic channel
planet_nadi_amsha_signs.mars: D-150 Mars sign = the precise karma of action and assertion
planet_nadi_amsha_signs.mercury: D-150 Mercury sign = the finest intellectual-communication karma
planet_nadi_amsha_signs.jupiter: D-150 Jupiter sign = the deepest wisdom and dharma channel
planet_nadi_amsha_signs.venus: D-150 Venus sign = the most refined relationship-beauty karma
planet_nadi_amsha_signs.saturn: D-150 Saturn sign = the precise karmic debt and discipline channel
planet_nadi_amsha_signs.rahu: D-150 Rahu sign = the exact foreign/unconventional karmic direction
planet_nadi_amsha_signs.ketu: D-150 Ketu sign = the most precise past-life liberation channel

kp_sublord_connection.description: In KP system, Nadi Amsha is the foundation of sublord theory
kp_sublord_connection.how_it_works: Each house cusp falls in a specific Nadi Amsha — the lord of that amsha is the 'sublord' of the cusp
sublord_rules: If sublord of a house is significator of another house, those houses' themes merge
Marriage (7th house): if sublord of 7th is in 11th — marriage through friends/network
Career (10th house): if sublord of 10th is Saturn — disciplined, slow-building career
Birth time accuracy critical — each minute shifts the cusp sublords

d150_vs_d60_comparison.d60_shastiamsha: 60 parts per sign (0.5°) — karmic patterns from past lives (Parashari)
d150_vs_d60_comparison.d150_nadi_amsha: 150 parts per sign (0.2°) — finest karmic resolution, KP sublords
d150_vs_d60_comparison.when_to_use_d150: For precise event timing when birth time is accurate to ±30 seconds
d150_vs_d60_comparison.when_to_use_d60: For broad karmic patterns when birth time is accurate to ±2 minutes

chart_reading_approach.step_1: Calculate D-150 position of all planets and Ascendant
chart_reading_approach.step_2: Identify which Nadi type (Adi/Madhya/Antya) each planet falls in
chart_reading_approach.step_3: Note the D-150 sign of each planet — its sublord quality
chart_reading_approach.step_4: Check if D-150 Lagna, D-1 Lagna, and D-9 Lagna are in same sign — triple alignment = powerful life theme
chart_reading_approach.step_5: Look for planets with same D-150 sign as Lagna — they operate at the soul level
chart_reading_approach.step_6: The D-150 Moon sign = the most refined emotional karma
